topic: free school lunch for every student
title: In Korea, School Lunch Is Free for Every Kid

slides.headline: In Korea, every school kid eats lunch **for free.**
slides.note: Rich or poor, first grade to senior year.

slides.headline: Every grade, **every kid**
slides.body: Elementary, middle and high schools serve a hot lunch, and families pay nothing for it. No forms, no income check.

slides.headline: A teacher **plans the menu**
slides.body: Schools have a nutrition teacher (영양교사) by law. They write the menu, check the ingredients and taste the food first.

slides.headline: Rice, soup, **and side dishes**
slides.body: A steel tray with rice, soup, kimchi and a few sides. Kids eat it together in the cafeteria or the classroom.

slides.headline: A lunch fight that **cost a mayor his job**
slides.body: In 2011 Seoul's mayor, against free lunch for all, staked his job on a city vote. Turnout fell short, and he resigned.

slides.headline: Why **everyone**, not just the poor
slides.body: Supporters argued that lunch only for poor kids marks them in front of classmates. Free for all hides who needs it.

slides.headline: Lunch is **part of school**
slides.body: Many countries leave lunch to a packed box or a cafeteria bill. Korea treats it like a classroom: the school provides it.

slides.headline: Of schools **serve it free**
slides.body: As of February 2021, all 11,903 Korean schools served free lunch, to about 5.4 million students.

slides.headline: In Korea, lunch is **a school subject.**
slides.body: Free for every kid, planned by a teacher, eaten together.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
In Korea, school lunch is free for every kid, from first grade to the last year of high school.

A nutrition teacher plans the menu, and no family fills out a form to get it.

Who pays for school lunch where you live?
reply: One more: the food in a Seoul elementary school lunch costs about 4,500 won, a little over three US dollars, and the city, the districts and the education office split the bill. What did school lunch look like where you grew up, and who paid for it?
fact_check: 2장: 초·중·고 전면 무상급식, 소득 확인 없음 — 2021-02 교육부 자료 기준 전국 1만1903개교 100% 무상급식 (뉴스토마토 '급식, 전쟁과 진화①').
3장: 영양교사 업무(식단 작성, 식재료 선정·검수, 검식) — 학교급식법 시행령 제8조(2007-01-20 시행), 한국교육신문 보도. 급식 시설 갖춘 학교에 영양교사·조리사 배치 — 학교급식법.
4장: 밥·국·김치·반찬 식판 구성, 급식실 또는 교실 배식 — 일반 관행.
5장: 오세훈 시장은 전면 무상급식 반대(소득 하위 50% 단계적 안), 주민투표 제안·시장직 연계. 2011-08-24 투표율 25.7%로 개표 요건 33.3% 미달, 2011-08-26 사퇴 발표 — 경향신문·머니투데이 2011-08.
6장: 선별급식의 낙인효과가 전면 무상급식 찬성 논거 — 2010~2011 무상급식 논쟁 보도, 일반 사실.
8장: 2021-02 전국 1만1903개교 100% 무상급식, 이용 학생 537만5천명 — 교육부 자료 인용 뉴스토마토.
댓글: 서울 초등 1식 식품비 4,553원(2026-03, 교육부 자료·한병도 의원실), 서울시 30%·자치구 20%·교육청 50% 분담 — 위키트리·노컷뉴스 보도. 환율 약 1,400원 기준 약 3.2달러.
